activity.title: Activity
activity.search: Search an action, a detail, an e-mail…
activity.scopeNote: What is done through Athanor that matters later: deployments, structure and data changes on databases, accounts and permissions, sessions, configuration. Plain reads are not recorded, and schema edits are in each project's own history. Entries cannot be edited or deleted; they are kept for the retention the instance sets (ATHANORDB_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS).
monitoring.title: Watch for changes made outside Athanor
monitoring.hint: Reads the project's databases on a schedule and compares them with the state the last deployment or pull left. A difference nothing in Athanor explains turns on the editor's banner and goes to the project's webhooks. A database that cannot be read is reported as unreachable, never as a change.
backups.title: Backups of this database

dictionary.title: Data dictionary
dictionary.hint: What each table and column means. Everything is stored in the schema's notes (“[owner: …] [class: …] [tags: …]” after the description): history, DBML export and imports carry it.
dictionary.search: Search a table, a column, a tag…
dictionary.filter.label: Filter tables
dictionary.empty: The schema has no table yet.

compareEnv.title: Compare two environments
compareEnv.hint: Reads the structure of both databases now and sets them side by side: what one has that the other lacks, table by table. Data is not compared.

environments.variablesInvalid: Variables: write name=value, separated by commas.

errors.stageSkipReasonRequired: Skipping a stage needs a reason.
pipeline.title: Pipeline

pipeline.waitsHint: The current schema must be deployed to {{stage}} first.

deployment.blockedByLint_other: This project refuses to deploy with open quality errors, and there are {{count}}: see the Problems tab.
deployment.waitsForStage: This stage waits for {{stage}}: the current schema must be deployed there first.
deployment.waitsForStageAdmin: This stage waits for {{stage}}: the current schema must be deployed there first. You will be able to skip the stage, with a reason, after the refusal.
tour.canvas.title: The diagram
tour.canvas.body: Each table is a block you move freely. Double-click a name to change it, drag from one column to another to create a relation, and right-click the background to add a table, a zone or a note.
tour.dbml.title: The same schema, as text
tour.dbml.body: This panel shows the schema in DBML. What you type here updates the diagram, and the other way round: paste an existing schema or edit several lines at once. Double-click a table in the text to find it on the diagram.
tour.toolbar.title: View and tools
tour.toolbar.body: Zoom, detail level, conceptual view (MCD), relation highlighting, schema problems, minimap, search and plugins: everything that sets how the diagram looks is here.
tour.shortcuts.title: A few shortcuts
tour.shortcuts.body: The most useful ones on the diagram (⌘ instead of Ctrl on a Mac):
tour.shortcut.search: find a table or a column
tour.shortcut.copyPaste: copy / paste tables, to another project too
tour.workspace.title: The rest of the project
tour.workspace.body: The tabs lead to the version history, the problems found in the schema, the data dictionary and, depending on your rights, the deployments and the data of the linked databases. Top right: import, export and this tour, to replay whenever you like.
backups.scope.title: Back up some tables
backups.scope.hint: A partial backup holds only the ticked tables; a restore from it will touch only those.
locks.relationLocked: This relation belongs to the locked table “{{table}}”: it cannot be created, changed or deleted.
